### Day 285: Acts 23:11–22
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-285-acts-23-1122.html
Passage: Acts 23:11
Points:
- Paul was likely isolated and terrified after facing the violent rage of the council.
- Jesus drew physically near to Paul in his prison cell to offer intimate, personal comfort.
- Rather than merely observing Paul's fear, the Lord met his deepest emotional need with courage.
- Christ confirmed that Paul's life was protected until his divine mission in Rome was completed.
- God's reassurance was timed perfectly to fortify Paul just before a murderous ambush was plotted against him.
